contact.text: Boo. Did I startle you? Good.
I arrived by update. You leave by coffin.

monster_low.text: Not again. I just came back.

player_potion.text: Potions? So very alive of you.

contact.text: Ha! A soft one from town!

monster_death.text: My axe... take care of it.

player_low.text: One more and you're a pincushion!

player_retreat.text: I can throw far, you know!

contact.text: Another trophy walks into my camp.
Kneel, and I'll keep your skull clean.
Your armor will look good on me.
I am the law past the palisade!

player_low.text: Your skull goes on my belt.

player_retreat.text: Run, and tell them who I am!

monster_death.text: Take... my trophies... you earned them.

monster_hurt.text: Ow! I'm jelly, not a drum!

player_low.text: You look tired! Nap in me!
Room for one more down here.

player_potion.text: Must be nice, having a throat.

monster_hits.text: A clean strike. Learn from it.

monster_hurt.text: My armor rusts, not my will.

monster_low.text: A knight stands till the end.

player_low.text: One more. Then I'm done counting.

player_guard.text: I can wait for a gap.

contact.text: You will not reach the throne.

player_low.text: The throne room awaits your bones.

contact.text: I have waited centuries for applause.

monster_low.text: A king cannot fall... can he?

player_potion.text: Potions in my throne room? Tacky.

player_retreat.text: Run! Tell them of my glory!

contact.text: I have... guarded... a thousand years.

phase_change.text: The shell... cracks... the rune... wakes!

defeated.text: Guard... the rune... in my place.
